newsitem.title: USA: Advanced Energy sets technology purchase.
newsitem.headline: Advanced Energy sets technology purchase.

text.p: Advanced Energy Industries Inc said Friday it has agreed to acquire the assets of MIK Physics Inc for an undisclosed sum.
The acquisition, which is subject to the approval of MIK's board, is expected to be completed by June 30.
Based in Madison, Wis., MIK is a development stage company that has developed a high-speed pulse power supply used in industrial vacuum coating.

The larger commercial industrial applications for this technology include oxygen-barrier films for food packaging, which are similar to the transparent versions of the opaque silvery potato chip packaging currently on the market, Advanced Energy Chief Technology Officer Richard Scholl said.
It will also produce insulating coatings for architectural glass and the anti-reflective films used for computer displays.

He said "The MIK technology greatly increases the speed at which these coatings can be applied on large areas, thus reducing the cost of this process and, therefore, making these applications commercially viable for the first time."
